The '''Yarma system''' was a [[star system]] in<ref name="Steps" /> the [[Tharin sector]]<ref name="Appendix" /> in which the [[planet]] [[Yarma]] was located. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], they operated a [[Reklam Station|salvage yard]] on Yarma.<ref name="Steps" />

Sometime after the [[Galactic Civil War]], the [[CR90 corvette]] ''[[Tantive IV]]'', the personal [[starship]] of [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in her teenage years, was discovered in a [[hangar]] in the Yarma system by a sympathetic former Imperial [[senator]] who returned it to Organa as a gift.<ref name="RoS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
